# Enemy Images

Put enemy images here to replace the placeholders on the battle screen.

- `enemy1.png`
- `enemy2.png`
- `enemy3.png`
- `enemy4.png`

Recommended format: transparent PNG, roughly square or 4:3. The app displays the image with `object-fit: contain`, so it will stay inside the enemy frame.

Current demo setup: `enemy1.png` through `enemy4.png` use the same green creature cutout from `HABURRO.png`.
